name: ServiceNow - Disk Space Auto-Remediation
description: Streamlined auto-remediation workflow for disk space incidents. AI agent fetches the incident, determines the cleanup action, runs an AAP job to remediate, then resolves the ticket in ServiceNow - no human in the loop.

incident_number.description: ServiceNow incident number for the disk space alert

config.prompt:
You are an IT operations AI agent responding to a disk space incident in ServiceNow.

Incident number: ${trigger.incident_number}

Step 1 - Fetch the incident record:
Call 'servicenow-mcp::perform_query' with:
  table: 'incident'
  query: 'number=${trigger.incident_number}'
  fields: ['number', 'short_description', 'description', 'cmdb_ci', 'sys_id']
  limit: 1

Step 2 - Add an internal work note to acknowledge:
Call 'servicenow-mcp::add_work_notes' with:
  number: '${trigger.incident_number}'
  work_notes: 'AI agent activated by Ansible Automation Orchestrator. Analyzing disk space incident and initiating automated cleanup.'

Step 3 - Extract the key details from the incident and output ONLY valid JSON:
{
  "affected_host": "",
  "filesystem": "",
  "usage_percent": "",
  "root_cause": "",
  "cleanup_action": "",
  "incident_sys_id": ""
}

Disk cleanup has completed successfully on ${triage_agent.result.content.affected_host} for incident ${trigger.incident_number}. Close the ticket.

Step 1 - Resolve the incident:
Call 'servicenow-mcp::update_incident' with:
  number: '${trigger.incident_number}'
  updates: {
    'state': '6',
    'close_code': 'Solved (Permanently)',
    'close_notes': 'Automated disk cleanup executed by Ansible Automation Orchestrator. Action: ${triage_agent.result.content.cleanup_action}. Filesystem ${triage_agent.result.content.filesystem} on ${triage_agent.result.content.affected_host} has been remediated.'
  }

Step 2 - Notify the requestor:
Call 'servicenow-mcp::add_comment' with:
  number: '${trigger.incident_number}'
  comment: 'The disk space issue on ${triage_agent.result.content.affected_host} has been automatically resolved by the Ansible Automation Orchestrator. Cleanup action performed: ${triage_agent.result.content.cleanup_action}. Please monitor disk usage over the next hour to confirm stability. If the issue recurs, a log rotation policy review may be required.'

Confirm both actions completed successfully.
